title: Books
subtitle: Book records for the labeling screen: file ↔ printed page offset, answer key pages and table of contents (grade and topic default per page).
selectHint: Pick a book from the list to edit it, or add a new one.
saveFailed: The book could not be saved.

editor.name: Book name
editor.canonicalHint: If the same content was printed under another name (e.g. an institutional edition), pick the original book.

offsets.title: Page offset
offsets.hint: Printed page = file page + offset. The offset may be negative; for a book in fascicles enter one range per fascicle.
offsets.empty: No offset ranges: printed pages are unknown.

toc.title: Table of contents
toc.hint: File page range → grade / subject / topic / subtopic. Becomes the page default on the labeling screen.
toc.subject: Subject

validation.fromRequired: Row {{row}}: enter the first file page.
validation.toRequired: Row {{row}}: enter the last file page.
validation.offsetRequired: Row {{row}}: enter the offset (whole number, may be negative).
validation.fromAfterTo: Row {{row}}: the start cannot be after the end.
validation.subTopicNeedsTopic: Row {{row}}: pick a topic before the subtopic.
validation.printedMin: Row {{row}}: the first printed page must be at least 1 (file from + offset ≥ 1).
validation.toMax: Row {{row}}: the last file page can be at most {{max}}.
validation.printedMax: Row {{row}}: the last printed page can be at most {{max}} (file to + offset).

delete.title: Delete book
delete.inUse: Questions were saved from this book, so it cannot be deleted.
delete.failed: The book could not be deleted.

discard.title: Unsaved changes
discard.message: Changes to this book were not saved. Discard them?

converter.title: Converter
converter.hint: Check file ↔ printed page conversion with the saved ranges (for books in fascicles).
converter.unsavedHint: There are unsaved changes: the converter uses the saved version.
converter.nearHint: If the printed number repeats across fascicles, the one closest to this file page comes first.
converter.tocStale: The table of contents entry is invalid (deleted topic)

renameForbidden: Only an admin can rename a shared book that is in use.
